article_title: Exploring pre-clinical medical students' perception of and participation in active learning: A mixed-methods transnational study.
citation: Heng W, Ho MH, Mah XH, Lim JJ, Syamsury NBHA, Haagensen E, Ong ELC, Hubbard P. (2025). Exploring pre‐clinical medical students' perception of and participation in active learning: A mixed‐methods transnational study. Medical Education. https://doi.org/10.1111/medu.15611
title: 66-item mixed-methods survey instrument combining ASPECT and Blended Learning Questionnaire items with free-text definition questions
description: A de novo 66-item questionnaire built on the JISC online survey platform, drawing statement items from two validated instruments, ASPECT and the Blended Learning Questionnaire, plus demographic and free-text questions. It deliberately avoided the words 'active' or 'passive'. It was analysed in SPSS with Mann–Whitney U tests and has not undergone formal psychometric evaluation.
requirements: Based on previously validated survey instruments (ASPECT and BLQ)
constraints: The article states the survey "has not undergone formal psychometric evaluation" and used convenience sampling with a 30% response rate
target_learning_goals: assessing student perceptions of and participation in active learning
examples: Distributed via e-mail link with anonymised data downloaded to Excel and analysed in SPSS; qualitative data collected via free text and near-peer-run focus groups transcribed through Microsoft Teams
key_sources: Heng W, Ho MH, Mah XH, Lim JJ, Syamsury NBHA, Haagensen E, Ong ELC, Hubbard P. (2025). Exploring pre‐clinical medical students' perception of and participation in active learning: A mixed‐methods transnational study. Medical Education. https://doi.org/10.1111/medu.15611
